# Ghar Ki Handi website rules

1. Brand name is "Ghar Ki Handi". Tagline is "Ghar jaisa khana, seedha hostel tak." Show both in the header of every page.
2. Tone: warm, friendly, short. Light Urdu words (garam, yaar, shukriya) inside clear English.
3. Colours: use only these. Terracotta #B5462F for buttons and headings, deep green #1F4D3A for header and footer, saffron #F2A93B for highlights and badges, cream #FFF7EC for the page background, charcoal #2B2B2B for body text.
4. Fonts: load from Google Fonts. Fraunces (bold) for headings, Nunito for body text and buttons.
5. Every page has a header (brand name, tagline, links to all pages), main content, and a footer with opening hours and "Delivering to all LUMS hostels".
6. Prices: write as "Rs 450", no decimals, comma for thousands ("Rs 1,200"). Never use "PKR" or "$".
7. Times: 12-hour format with lowercase am/pm, for example "9:30 pm". Open 7:00 pm to 1:00 am, every day.
8. Phone numbers: written as 0300-1234567. Every form accepts a phone number only if it has exactly 11 digits and starts with 03.
9. Menu items sit on rounded cards with one food emoji, the dish name, a one-line description, the price and a spice level of one to three 🌶️.
10. Ordering: visitors add and remove items and see a running total. Delivery costs Rs 100 and is free on orders of Rs 1,500 or more.
11. Layout: mobile first, readable at 375px wide. Buttons: 12px rounded corners, at least 44px tall.
12. Never use stock photos, external image links, lorem ipsum or placeholder text. Use emoji and real copy.
